newsitem.title: USA: Shared Technologies Fairchild stake held.
newsitem.headline: Shared Technologies Fairchild stake held.

text.p: A group led by New York investor J.J. Cramer said Thursday it holds a 5.1 percent stake in Shared Technologies Fairchild Inc or 775,100 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 312,000 common shares between Dec 17, 1996, and Feb 14 at $7.50 to $9.25 per share.
The group holds the stake for investment.
Shared Technologies Fairchild, based in Wethersfield, Conn., provides building-wide telecommunications services throughout the United States.
